lines.q: Which animal kills the most people every year?
lines.a: The mosquito! Not the shark. It spreads malaria and other diseases.

lines.q: Which animal has the biggest eyes on Earth?
lines.a: The colossal squid! Each eye is about the size of a football. Didn't see that coming, right?

lines.q: What is the dot on a lowercase i called?
lines.a: A tittle! Yes, that's really the word.

lines.q: Last one. What colour is a plane's black box?
lines.a: Orange! Bright orange, so searchers can find it after a crash.
